# STA Corporate Solutions

> STA Corporate Solutions — Transportation since 1982 (43+ years of service excellence). Financial Services, Legal Services, Edu Consultancy and Real Estate practices launched mid-2025. Five integrated practices for South India, headquartered in Coimbatore.

STA Transport & Logistics has provided Full Load lorry transport from Coimbatore since 1982, serving Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Kerala. In mid-2025, STA Corporate Solutions expanded into four new verticals under one umbrella: Financial Services (MSME, Mudra, PMEGP and government funding scheme guidance), Legal Services (property, corporate, business and registration), Edu Consultancy (academic mobility and degree transfer), and Real Estate (property discovery across South India). Headquartered in Peelamedu, Coimbatore. Contact: +91 94430 33055.
